fitting_scope: all target cohort; descriptive transductive analysis

readouts.raw_distance_profile: Paired-gene panel; cohort coordinate standardization; RMS over jointly observed entries.
readouts.direct_bin_difference: Paired-gene panel; cohort coordinate standardization; RMS over jointly observed entries.
readouts.continuous_moments_abs_difference: Paired-gene panel; cohort coordinate standardization; RMS over jointly observed entries.
readouts.pair_mask: Same paired-gene panel; binary availability; Jaccard.
readouts.distance_scalar: Median of observed gene distances; standardized one-dimensional RMS.
readouts.gene_shuffled_distance: Row permutation including missing entries; standardized RMS; mask not preserved.
readouts.u_bin_profile: State-specific eligibility; zero bins unavailable; cohort standardization and RMS.
readouts.s_bin_profile: State-specific eligibility; zero bins unavailable; cohort standardization and RMS.
readouts.mu_profile: State-specific positive-observation eligibility; moment zeros numerical; standardization and RMS.
readouts.ms_profile: State-specific positive-observation eligibility; moment zeros numerical; standardization and RMS.
readouts.u_only: Mean U vector over paired eligible genes; 128D; cohort standardization and RMS.
readouts.s_only: Mean S vector over paired eligible genes; 128D; cohort standardization and RMS.
readouts.concatenated_u_s: Concatenated mean U and mean S vectors over paired eligible genes; 256D; cohort standardization and RMS.
readouts.state: Elementwise mean of mean U and mean S vectors; 128D; cohort standardization and RMS.
readouts.u_hidden_sum_profile: Sum hidden coordinates per gene; own state-specific observed panel; not full vectors or norms; standardization and RMS.
readouts.s_hidden_sum_profile: Sum hidden coordinates per gene; own state-specific observed panel; not full vectors or norms; standardization and RMS.
readouts.concat_hidden_sum_profile: Sum hidden coordinates per gene; own state-specific observed panel; not full vectors or norms; standardization and RMS.
readouts.calibrated_distance_profile: All-cohort gene median and bin-pair residual correction, gene MAD scaling; paired panel, standardization, RMS; not cross-fit.
readouts.scFoundation: Native shiftlog|pearson filtering and 3072D pooling; Euclidean.
readouts.scVI: Target-trained 10 epochs, raw U+S, 128D, 2 layers, ZINB, learning rate .01; Euclidean.
readouts.expression_u_counts: Source count gene space; raw or log1p counts; numerical zeros; Euclidean, no additional readout-stage normalization.
readouts.expression_u_log1p: Source count gene space; raw or log1p counts; numerical zeros; Euclidean, no additional readout-stage normalization.
readouts.expression_s_counts: Source count gene space; raw or log1p counts; numerical zeros; Euclidean, no additional readout-stage normalization.
readouts.expression_s_log1p: Source count gene space; raw or log1p counts; numerical zeros; Euclidean, no additional readout-stage normalization.
readouts.expression_u_plus_s_counts: Source count gene space; raw or log1p counts; numerical zeros; Euclidean, no additional readout-stage normalization.
readouts.expression_u_plus_s_log1p: Source count gene space; raw or log1p counts; numerical zeros; Euclidean, no additional readout-stage normalization.
readouts.scvelo_stochastic: Target-fitted velocity producer; signed finite nonconstant producer genes; Euclidean. No transition-direction evaluation.
readouts.scvelo_dynamical: Target-fitted velocity producer; signed finite nonconstant producer genes; Euclidean. No transition-direction evaluation.

producer_snapshot_scope: Paths identify code snapshots in the local evidence package, outside this document-only source archive. These producers are not required or executed by make check.
